column1: # Reviewed list of Tier 1 groups allowed to finish as NOMANIF and still count toward the
# corpus stage's pass==checked check (bead oo-88hv). Read by the corpus.sh `tally` subcommand,
# which tools/tier-b.sh and tools/tier-c.sh use to count passing groups.
# NOMANIF (oxp_load_check.py, bead oo-kcrw) means: the expansion LOADED and EVERY error line
# in the run is the standards complaint "[oxp-standards.error]: OXP <member> has no
# manifest.plist". One extra error line of any kind and the verdict is ERRORS, which never
# counts. This list adds a second condition on top of that: the group must be named here, with
# a reason. A manifest-less group that is NOT listed (a catalogue expansion, a new fixture)
# still counts as not passing, so the full tier goes red until someone reviews it and adds it.
# Every entry must be one of the in-tree test-oxps in tools/oxp-corpus/tier1.json
# ("test_oxps"), must fit the 44-column name field of the verdict line, and must carry a reason.
# `tally` refuses (exit 2) a list that breaks any of those rules.
# Format: <group name as printed on the verdict line><TAB><reason>
